title: Zesty Nutty Portuguese Burrata Paella
description: A one-pot Portuguese dish featuring burrata, with a zesty and nutty flavor profile, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the toasted pine nuts and cook for 1 minute, stirring frequently.
Add the Spanish rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add the yuzu juice, turmeric, paprika, sea salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Slice the burrata cheese and place on top of the rice mixture.
Cover the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and creamy.
